subject: Banking
title: Payday Lending Traps
description: A short lesson to help you apply Payday Lending Traps.

hook.text: Payday loans charge 400% annual interest. Borrowers pay $15 per $100 every two weeks.

buildup.text: Payday lenders target low-income neighborhoods. The average borrower makes $30,000 a year and takes 8 loans annually.

discovery.text: 75% of payday loan fees come from borrowers who take 10+ loans per year.

twist.text: Major banks funded payday lenders. Wells Fargo and US Bank invested in companies they'd never lend from directly.

climax.text: Payday lending is legal usury. Banks profit from poverty by funding lenders that charge 400% to the most vulnerable.

punchline.text: 400% interest. 80% repeating. Banks funded the lenders targeting the poor.

quiz.question: What percentage of payday loan fees come from repeat borrowers?
